units.source_text: 禅海和尚一边呷酒，一边直勾勾地凝视着我。

en.t: Abbot Zenkai sipped his sake while staring fixedly at me.

units.source_text: 我感到被雨水濡湿的鹿苑寺又大又黑的瓦房顶般的沉默的重量，压在我的身上。

en.t: I felt the weight of a silence like the great black tiled roof of Rokuonji, soaked by the rain, pressing down on my body.

units.source_text: 神海和尚突然发出了特别爽朗的笑声。

en.t: Abbot Shinkai suddenly gave a particularly hearty laugh.
